scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF comparison across explicit 3D entities, ACIS carriers, complex-record framing, and silent output loss; reconcile evidence into the existing plan without creating duplicate findings.

method.kind: Official Autodesk DXF/API documentation, current ezdxf API documentation, current public peer issue reports, and local plan/source/test-owner crosswalk
method.evidenceBoundary: Autodesk documentation supplies DXF/API contract evidence. Peer issues are reporter/maintainer claims scoped to their stated versions and inputs, not reproduced here and not evidence of an equivalent libdxfrw defect. ezdxf limitations describe its documented profile, not all open-source implementations.

evidence.topic: Explicit mesh versus modeler carrier contract
observed: The 3DSOLID DXF wrapper has modeler-version and proprietary group 1/3 carrier fields, followed by an optional group-350 soft-owner/history-object reference.
MESH explicitly carries subdivision, vertex, face, edge, crease, and per-subentity override data.

POLYLINE mode flags select distinct 2D, 3D, polygon-mesh, and polyface structures; polyface child VERTEX records use coordinate/face roles, signed 1-based indices, and negative-index edge-visibility semantics.
doesNotEstablish: that the optional group-350 history object is necessary for geometric display/import
that a MESH or POLYFACE projection is a boundary-representation solid
evidence.planUse: Keep wrapper bytes, optional history-link closure, explicit polygon topology, and semantic solid metrics as separate evidence rows. Preserve existing 7V/PAR-37 and Slice8/S8 owners.

observed: Autodesk's complex-entity construction reference describes legacy POLYLINE VERTEX sequences and INSERT ATTRIB sequences ending with SEQEND; the legacy construction examples use group 66 equal to 1.
The POLYLINE DXF code table describes group 66 as obsolete/optional and to be ignored when present.
evidence.planUse: Version-scope group-66 checks; test actual child record framing, terminal SEQEND/ENDBLK, and following-record alignment independently so no version-independent rule is inferred from one API-construction guide.

observed: Current stable documentation identifies ezdxf 1.4.5, states arbitrary existing ACIS structures are not a project goal, and says unsupported entities are loaded as NONE_ENTITY with data loss.
The project documents no ACIS kernel; its mesh extraction returns flat polygonal faces only, so curved faces are lost without a kernel.
The documented carrier versions include SAT v700 for DXF R2000-R2010 and SAB v21800 for R2013/R2018.
evidence.planUse: Pin exact ezdxf version and selected schema; capture unsupported record and payload dispositions. Do not promote arbitrary ACIS preservation, curved-shape semantics, or kernel correctness from a successful ezdxf load/export.

evidence.topic: Current peer-reported silent loss and framing failures
observed: LibreDWG #1411 reports modern AcDs/SAB geometry loss while REGION/3DSOLID/BODY records survive.
LibreDWG #1409/#1357 report empty block/layout output and early traversal termination after an unresolved entity reference.
LibreDWG #1351 reports malformed INSERT attribute sequence framing; #1410 reports valid zero-valued HATCH data and embedded MTEXT attribute fields mishandled on input.
ACadSharp #1195 reports 3DSOLID/REGION omission on DXF writing, including solid-only blocks.
doesNotEstablish: current behavior at unpinned future peer revisions
that raw record survival proves payload or semantic geometry survival
evidence.planUse: Cross-reference existing emitted identity/owner closure, complex sequence, zero-value, and AcDs carrier gates; treat each issue as a test-design lead only and do not duplicate findings without local contradictory evidence.

evidence.topic: R2004+ CMC test-vector correction from ODA
evidence.source: Repository-local ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1, §2.11 (available locally; not downloaded in this review)
evidence.observed: The R2004+ CMC BS color index is specified as always zero.
evidence.planUse: Keep valid generated CMC vectors fixed at BS=0. If nonzero BS is tested, mark it malformed-input coverage only; do not vary it as a valid method/index discriminator.

nextActions: Continue local slices with the strict touched-target build and the nearest generated fast test; do not wait for external CAD, peer, or kernel availability.
For explicit MESH/POLYFACE, validate exact tags, topology/index roles, versioned child framing, and following-record alignment in existing fast test owners.
For modeler entities, record carrier bytes/association and optional history-edge closure separately from kernel shape validity and native application acceptance.
At one existing composed inventory checkpoint, reconcile source handle and owner/block path to emitted, explicitly refused/reported, or documented unsupported/lost status.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
